Sandbox_DansVanillaFixesColdPackHours_to:
How long one fully frozen cold pack keeps a cooler cold, in game hours. Packs in the same cooler add up: three frozen packs last three times as long.
A fridge chills a pack half way, a freezer fully.
Sandbox_DansVanillaFixesWashFloorNoSoap_:
How dirty or bloody clothes stay after washing them by hand without soap, per patch. Washing never makes anything dirtier.
A washing machine (or a combo washer/dryer) still gets them fully clean. 0 = vanilla.
Sandbox_DansVanillaFixesWashFloorSoap_to:
How dirty or bloody clothes stay after washing them by hand with soap, per patch.
A washing machine (or a combo washer/dryer) still gets them fully clean. 0 = vanilla.
